reason: I already have a site, old but it's there, and guests mostly find me on the platform or walk in from the riva. Putting €600 plus €15 a month on top of the commission I already pay, with no proof it brings one extra table, is not something I'd do this week.
objection: €600 is a lot when I don't know if it brings any bookings. Nobody can tell me how many guests will come from the website instead of the platform.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a konoba or restaurant nearby that got real WhatsApp bookings from a site like this, or paying half now and the rest only after the season if it brought guests.
